allowed_metadata_access: official landing pages and dataset papers
official repository text, calibration text, and metadata figures
ScienceDB JSON-LD and file-tree metadata API
HTTP HEAD for exact candidate objects
Internet Archive copies of historical official CoRBS HTML

local_access_audit.interpretation: No evidence was found that the exact CID-SIMS Floor3, CoRBS E3, or KITTI-360 candidate identities had previously been accessed or influenced RCLE selection. This is a bounded repository and filename audit, not a claim about every external machine or person.

dataset_authority.license_boundary: Isolated non-commercial research and reproduction are compatible; attribution is required, commercial use is forbidden, and adapted payload or derivative material must not be shared.

coordinate_chain.camera: Intel RealSense D455 aligned RGB and depth, 640x480 at 30 fps
coordinate_chain.camera_axes: right-handed optical frame: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward
coordinate_chain.depth_to_color: T_DtoC is the identity matrix in the published calibration
coordinate_chain.camera_to_world: Published ground-truth rows encode camera-to-world translation and unit quaternion.
coordinate_chain.static_geometry: GeoSLAM trajectory and scene point cloud share a coordinate system; trajectories are transformed into the unified world frame.
coordinate_chain.pixel_to_world: deproject aligned depth with cam_k and Z_m in the camera optical frame, then apply the source-native camera-to-world pose

candidates.domain_boundary: Real indoor ground-wheeled robot at approximately 0.26 m high or 0.12 m low; not head-worn and not human efficacy evidence.
candidates.r2_constraint: A separate pre-payload R2 contract must choose exactly one of floor3_1, floor3_2, or floor3_3 by an outcome-blind deterministic rule and bind its file ID, MD5, byte size, canonical entry, source descriptor hash, admission contract, and exclusive claim before any GET.

coordinate_chain.camera: Microsoft Kinect v2 raw color, depth, and infrared; pre-registered color/depth are also defined
coordinate_chain.camera_axes: TUM RGB-D optical convention inherited by the published format: +X image-right, +Y image-down, +Z forward; this is inherited strong evidence rather than a direct CoRBS axis statement
coordinate_chain.pose: OptiTrack world to marker rigid body, then hand-eye marker-to-color-camera transform applied to the published trajectory
coordinate_chain.depth: Raw depth-to-color transform is applied for pre-registered data
coordinate_chain.static_geometry: Scanner-local geometry is scaled and rigidly aligned to the motion-capture global frame; the paper states all published data share one global coordinate system

candidates.sequence_identity_authority: Official kitti360Scripts repository example and official sequence naming contract
candidates.access_requirement: Registration and intended-purpose declaration are required before download and use.

perspective_train_val.entry: official download_2d_perspective.zip helper from the KITTI-360 download page

coordinate_chain.pose: poses.txt is IMU-to-world; cam0_to_world.txt is rectified perspective camera-0 to world
coordinate_chain.calibration: calib_cam_to_pose maps camera to GPS/IMU; calib_cam_to_velo maps camera-0 to Velodyne
coordinate_chain.depth: No source-native dense RGB-D depth is advertised; raw Velodyne and SICK scans are the geometry sensors
coordinate_chain.static_geometry: Accumulated static PLY point clouds are already expressed in the world coordinate system

candidates.domain_boundary: Forward-facing perspective cameras on a station wagon in urban driving; vehicle-domain stress only.

required_before_any_payload_get: freeze one exact Floor3 sequence/archive using an outcome-blind deterministic rule
freeze complete source descriptor and SHA-256
freeze burned/exclusion and cross-program access vector
freeze identity, ancestry, independence, reuse, and confirmation isolation
freeze admission contract and exclusive claim semantics
bind the selected ScienceDB file ID, MD5, exact byte size, and canonical URL
forbidden: repair or rerun ETH3D sofa_3 R1
select one Floor3 archive from trajectory descriptions or geometry outcomes
fallback to another Floor3 run, CoRBS, or KITTI-360 after an R2 claim
download RGB, depth, pose, or pointcloud before the R2 preaccess lock
run geometry, RGB algorithm, or performance qualification
open confirmation, Kill Gate B, Replay, Android, human, safety, or production claims
